Bettina, I couldn't set up the recurring digest. The scheduler refused the request with "gateway cron requires credentials," and I can't fix gateway auth from here, so nothing is scheduled yet and nothing will post on Monday 19 October.

Here's what I'd set up once the scheduler works:

- **Schedule:** Mondays at 08:00 America/Chicago, starting Monday 19 October.
- **Sources:** only #coastal-team and #coastal-random, for the previous seven days, plus open customer items raised in those two channels. #coastal-random has the same members as this channel, so nothing new is exposed.
- **Left out:** money terms and finance documents (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices, payment terms, contracts, order forms, amendments). Those belong with Anselm, June, or the account owner, so they won't go in a channel.

An admin needs to restore the gateway's cron credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create the job and run one test digest.
